goal: Hollywood-style replica of the the client St. Louis brewery campus for the the client NH3 training video: every building, street and yard reads as the real place at review quality, matching the references; safety values stay global.

command: for s in bc_wide_production bc_wide_logistics bc_arsenal_west bc_arsenal_w6 bc_dock_court bc_broadway_docks bc_substation bc_muster stl_s27 stl_s28; do systemd-run --user --scope --nice=10 -p CPUQuota=800% -- ${repo}/media/nh3-kit/tools/blender-cpu -t 8 -P ${repo}/media/nh3-kit/trial/yard/campus_v2/districts/B_production/src/bc_review.py -- $s --out ${out}/$s.png --after || exit 1; done

index: /ref/docs/REFERENCE-INDEX.md (every source; Craig's private photos are listed there and are viewed locally only)
/ref/kit-pack: buildings.md, BUILDING-BRIEFS.md, EVIDENCE-INDEX.md, photos/, drawings/ (HABS), sanborn/, lidar/, osm/
/ref/survey-pack: photo-inventory.csv, evidence-index.csv, photos/, supplement-photos/, hillclimb/ (references added by earlier rounds)

critique.rubric: Judge each still as a production designer would before a film shoot: accuracy to the St. Louis references (massing, materials, colour, signage, layout); realism (scale, ground contact, weathering, repetition, texture resolution, lighting and exposure); completeness (no placeholders, blockout, floating or clipping geometry, empty lots or empty horizon); NH3 rules (orange #DE6737 pipe, bands at 40 ft or less, AMMONIA markers before and after every change of direction or penetration); brand rules (official artwork only, never mirrored, never on safety signs). Ignore render noise at 16 spp.

A.describe: district A historic core buildings and extras (Brew House, Bevo, Lyon School, stock houses, power plant, stable, gates, walkway furniture)
A.brief: Edit builders, facade.py or kit.py; the host rebuilds and re-promotes through promote_A.py. Report which buildings need rebuilding.

BC.describe: districts B (production) and C (logistics): utility blocks, tanks, silos, steel structures, docks, trucks, substation
BC.brief: Edit the bc_* generators; keep bc_gate.py and the Compressor Hall relief-vent clearance passing. Report which modules need re-promoting.

G.describe: campus ground and city context: terrain, paving, streets and markings, curbs, grass, rails, trees, vehicles, the city beyond the campus edge

Y.describe: lane Y yard scenes: lighting, sky, exposure, night looks, Compressor Hall, condensers and NH3 roof piping, rooftop signs
Y.brief: Never modify the frozen r24 responder. Brand marks are official artwork only.

gates: git diff --name-only HEAD | grep '\.py$' | xargs -r python3 -m py_compile
